emergency_number.note: Do NOT hardcode a nationwide Iraqi number. The only government-published number verified is 122, described by the KRG as an Erbil health-directorate ambulance line, explicitly regional in scope. Numbers circulating on telecom/aggregator pages do not meet this project's sourcing bar. Resolve per user region and verify with the Iraqi Ministry of Health before release.

NWAS-HB.title: NHS North West Ambulance Service — Heavy bleeding

NWAS-FA.title: NHS North West Ambulance Service — First aid facts leaflet (PDF)

BRC-UNB.title: British Red Cross — Unresponsive and not breathing

ARC-TQ.title: American Red Cross — How to apply a tourniquet

ARC-FAS.title: American Red Cross — First aid steps (CHECK-CALL-CARE)

SJA-CG.title: St John Ambulance — Cuts and grazes

WHO-CFAR.title: WHO — Community First Aid Response Pocket Guide (PDF)

high_confidence_signals.signal: bleeding cannot be stopped or slowed with pressure
blood rapidly soaking through dressing after dressing
blood volume about half a soda can, less for infants and small children
bright red blood, hard to control
amputation of a limb or digit
penetrating mechanism: gunshot, stabbing, power tool, serious road traffic collision

uncertain_behavior.note: Never gate the entry action on clarification. Start direct pressure first, then ask at most these three, in order, and stop asking the moment any high-confidence signal appears.

entry_action.title_ar: اضغط بقوة على مكان النزيف الآن
entry_action.title_en: Press hard on the wound. Now.
entry_action.description_ar: استخدم أي قماش نظيف أو يدك مباشرة. لا تؤخر الضغط بحثًا عن معدات.
entry_action.description_en: Use any clean cloth, or your bare hand. Do not delay pressure to look for supplies.

global_escalations.reason_en: Blood soaking through dressing after dressing

nodes.title_en: Keep pressing. Call the ambulance now.
nodes.description_ar: شغّل مكبر الصوت لتبقى يداك على الجرح.
nodes.description_en: Put the phone on speaker so both hands stay on the wound.
nodes.source_note: Sequencing divergence: BRC-BH, SJA-SB and WHO-CFAR put hands-on-wound before the call; NWAS-HB states calling 999 is the most important first action. Speakerphone satisfies both.

nodes.title_ar: اصرخ لطلب المساعدة ولا تترك المصاب
nodes.title_en: Shout for help. Do not leave them.
nodes.description_ar: استمر بالضغط. أوقف أي شخص يمر واطلب منه الاتصال.
nodes.description_en: Keep pressing. Stop anyone passing and have them call.

nodes.question_ar: هل يوجد جسم مغروس داخل الجرح؟
nodes.question_en: Is there an object stuck in the wound?

nodes.title_en: Do NOT pull the object out.
nodes.description_ar: اضغط على جانبي الجرح حوله، وابنِ حشوة حوله ثم ضمّد فوق الحشوة.
nodes.description_en: Press either side of it. Build padding around it, then bandage over the padding.
nodes.source_note: BRC-BH: it is helping plug the hole. NWAS-FA: build up padding around it before bandaging.

nodes.description_ar: بإحكام يكفي للضغط، دون أن يقطع الدورة الدموية.
nodes.description_en: Firm enough to hold pressure. Not so tight it goes numb or blue.

nodes.title_ar: اضغط على ظفر بعد الضماد ٥ ثوانٍ
nodes.title_en: Press a fingernail below the bandage for 5 seconds.
nodes.description_ar: إذا لم يعد اللون خلال ثانيتين، خفّف الضماد قليلًا.
nodes.description_en: If colour does not return within 2 seconds, loosen it slightly.

nodes.question_ar: هل ما زال الدم يتدفق بقوة أو يشبع الضماد رغم الضغط؟
nodes.question_en: Is blood still flowing hard or soaking through, despite pressure?

junctional_or_torso.ar: الرقبة، الكتف، الإبط، أعلى الفخذ، الظهر أو الجذع
junctional_or_torso.en: Neck, shoulder, armpit, groin, back or torso

amputation.en: A body part has been cut off

nodes.source_note: ARC-TQ limits tourniquets to arm or leg. ARC-LTB names scalp, neck, shoulder, groin, back and limbs as wound-packing sites.
ARC-TQ: if no tourniquet is available, use direct pressure.

nodes.title_ar: ضع العاصبة على الطرف فوق الجرح
nodes.title_en: Put the tourniquet on the limb, above the wound.
nodes.description_ar: لا تضعها فوق مفصل أبدًا. شدّها حتى يتوقف النزيف تمامًا.
nodes.description_en: Never on a joint. Tighten until the bleeding stops completely.
nodes.source_note: DISAGREEMENT dis_tq_placement — authorities agree on above-the-wound and never-on-a-joint, but differ on exact distance and elbow/knee preference. Show shared rule only.

nodes.title_en: Write down the time you applied it.
nodes.description_ar: لا تفكّها إطلاقًا. الطاقم الطبي فقط من يفكّها.
nodes.description_en: Never loosen it. Only a medical professional removes it.
nodes.source_note: Time recording from SJA-LTB and WHO-CFAR; the ARC-TQ page does not mention it. Never-loosen from ARC-TQ and SJA-LTB.

nodes.question_ar: هل توقف النزيف بعد شدّ العاصبة؟
nodes.question_en: Has the bleeding stopped after tightening?

nodes.title_en: Apply a second tourniquet above the first.
nodes.description_ar: أقرب إلى القلب من الأولى. إن لم تتوفر، استمر بالضغط المباشر بأقصى قوة.
nodes.description_en: Closer to the heart than the first. If you have none, keep maximum direct pressure.
nodes.source_note: ARC-TQ: if the first is as tight as possible and bleeding continues, apply a second above it, closer to the heart.

nodes.title_en: Pack the deep wound with clean material.
nodes.description_ar: ادفع القماش داخل الجرح، ثم اضغط بقوة فوقه خمس دقائق على الأقل دون رفع اليد.
nodes.description_en: Push the cloth into the wound, then press hard on top for at least 5 minutes without lifting.
nodes.source_note: WHO-CFAR: place clean material into deep bleeding areas. ARC-LTB: packing for scalp, neck, shoulder, groin, back, limb (if trained). SJA-LTB: haemostatic pad held tightly minimum 5 minutes, packed tightly into the wound where needed.

nodes.description_ar: السيطرة على النزيف أولًا. إن كان ذراعًا أو ساقًا ولم يتوقف النزيف، استخدم عاصبة.
nodes.description_en: Control the bleeding first. If it is an arm or leg and bleeding continues, use a tourniquet.
nodes.source_note: WHO-CFAR lists arm or leg amputation as a danger sign of severe life-threatening haemorrhage.

nodes.title_ar: احفظ الجزء المقطوع وأرسله مع المصاب
nodes.title_en: Keep the severed part. Send it with them.
nodes.description_ar: ضعه في كيس نايلون أو لُفّه بغلاف بلاستيكي، وتأكد أنه يذهب معه إلى المستشفى.
nodes.description_en: Put it in a plastic bag or wrap it in cling film, and make sure it goes to hospital with them.
nodes.source_note: SOURCING GAP — NWAS-FA is the only reviewed authority giving severed-part handling. NHS national, ARC, BRC and SJA public pages do not cover preservation. Do NOT add cooling or ice instructions; no reviewed authority supports them. Partial amputation is likewise unsourced: instruct only 'do not pull the part away'.

nodes.title_en: Lay them down. Raise their legs.
nodes.description_ar: ساقاه أعلى من مستوى القلب. فك الملابس الضيقة عند الرقبة والصدر والخصر.
nodes.description_en: Legs higher than the heart. Loosen tight clothing at neck, chest and waist.

nodes.title_en: Cover them to keep warm. Reassure them.
nodes.description_ar: استخدم معطفًا أو بطانية. استمر بالكلام معه.
nodes.description_en: Use a coat or blanket. Keep talking to them.

nodes.question_ar: نادِ عليه بصوت عالٍ وهزّ كتفيه. هل يستجيب؟
nodes.question_en: Call his name loudly and shake his shoulders. Does he respond?

nodes.title_en: Tilt his head back. Lift his chin.
nodes.description_ar: يد على الجبهة، وإصبعان تحت الذقن.
nodes.description_en: One hand on the forehead, two fingers under the chin.

nodes.question_ar: انظر واستمع للتنفس ١٠ ثوانٍ. هل يتنفس بشكل طبيعي؟
nodes.question_en: Look and listen for breathing for 10 seconds. Is he breathing normally?
nodes.hint_en: Occasional gasping is NOT normal breathing.
nodes.source_note: SJA-PS: agonal gasping is not normal breathing. ARC-FAS: check no more than 10 seconds.

nodes.description_ar: أعد فحص الدورة الدموية كل ١٠ دقائق حتى وصول الإسعاف.
nodes.description_en: Recheck circulation every 10 minutes until the ambulance arrives.

nodes.title_ar: لا ترفع يدك. أضف حشوة فوق الضماد
nodes.title_en: Do not lift your hand. Add padding on top.
nodes.description_ar: استمر بالضغط بقوة أكبر، وأخبر الإسعاف أن النزيف لا يتوقف.
nodes.description_en: Press harder and tell the ambulance the bleeding is not stopping.
nodes.source_note: DISAGREEMENT dis_dressing — NWAS-HB says add bandages over the first rather than removing it; BRC-BH and SJA-SB say replace the saturated material with fresh while maintaining pressure. Resolved toward layering because it carries no risk of dislodging a forming clot; the replace option is documented in dis_dressing.

nodes.question_ar: هل الدم يفور ويقفز، أم يسيل بثبات؟
nodes.question_en: Is the blood spurting and pumping, or flowing steadily?

nodes.question_ar: اضغط الآن بقماش نظيف. هل الدم ينفذ من خلاله أم يخف؟
nodes.question_en: Press now with a clean cloth. Is blood soaking straight through, or slowing?

nodes.question_ar: هل لونه شاحب، جلده بارد أو متعرق، يدوخ، أو لا يرد عليك بشكل طبيعي؟
nodes.question_en: Are they pale, cold or sweaty, dizzy, or not answering you normally?

UNRESPONSIVE_BREATHING.reason_ar: لا يستجيب لكنه يتنفس بشكل طبيعي
carry_over: maintain direct pressure on the wound

CARDIAC_ARREST.reason_ar: لا يستجيب ولا يتنفس بشكل طبيعي
carry_over: maintain pressure only if a second helper is present

MINOR_WOUND.reason_en: Bleeding stopped and wound is superficial

MEDICAL_HAEMORRHAGE.reason_ar: نزيف شديد من الأنف أو الفم أو الأمعاء أو المهبل دون إصابة
MEDICAL_HAEMORRHAGE.reason_en: Severe bleeding from nose, mouth, bowels or vagina without trauma

precedence_rules.rule: Catastrophic bleeding is addressed before airway when identified at the Response step
Once the person is not breathing normally, CPR becomes the primary flow; maintain wound pressure only if a second helper is present
Shock care runs concurrently with bleeding control and never replaces it

never_do.rule_ar: لا تنزع أي جسم مغروس في الجرح
never_do.rule_en: Never remove an object embedded in the wound

never_do.rule_ar: لا تضغط مباشرة فوق الجسم المغروس
never_do.rule_en: Never press directly on top of an embedded object
Never wash a heavily bleeding wound — it increases bleeding
Never loosen or remove a tourniquet once applied
Never place a tourniquet on a joint

never_do.rule_ar: لا تتوقف عن الشدّ بسبب الألم
never_do.rule_en: Do not stop tightening because the person is in pain

never_do.rule_ar: لا تشدّ الضماد لدرجة قطع الدورة الدموية
never_do.rule_en: Do not bandage so tightly that circulation is lost

never_do.rule_ar: لا تترك المصاب لتبحث عن جهاز صدمات
never_do.rule_en: Do not leave the casualty to go looking for a defibrillator

never_do.rule_ar: لا تؤخر الضغط بحثًا عن قفازات أو ضماد مناسب
never_do.rule_en: Do not delay pressure to find gloves or a proper dressing

excluded_unsourced.note: None of NHS, ARC, BRC, SJA or WHO supports these in the pages reviewed. Do not add them.
items: applying ice to a bleeding wound or to a severed part
blind packing of neck or chest wounds
loosening a tourniquet to restore circulation

positions.position: Replace the saturated material with fresh, maintaining firm pressure
Add additional bandages over the first rather than removing it

disagreements.app_resolution: Layer on top. Never release pressure to swap.

positions.position: Elevate the injured limb above heart or chest level
Elevation is not included in severe-bleeding steps; SJA-SB instead supports the limb with a sling

disagreements.app_resolution: Offer elevation as secondary only. It must never interrupt direct pressure.

disagreements.topic: When to reach for a tourniquet

positions.position: Last resort, after pressure, packing, wrapping and elevation have failed
A primary care option for life-threatening limb bleeding, alongside direct pressure
Dedicated life-threatening-bleed pathway, after calling emergency services

disagreements.app_resolution: Surface once pressure has visibly failed, or immediately when blood is pumping from a limb.

positions.position: 2–3 inches above the wound, between wound and heart, never on a joint
Close to and above the injury; below the elbow or knee is best; never on a joint

disagreements.app_resolution: State only the shared rule: above the wound, never on a joint. Do not invent a single distance.

open_items: Verify the correct emergency number per Iraqi region with the Ministry of Health before release.
Severed-part preservation beyond bag/cling-film is unsourced across all five authorities — keep the branch minimal.
Partial amputation has no public protocol in the reviewed sources — instruct only 'do not pull the part away'.
